records.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro intake and status history, the Snowflake extract, adjuster_notes.md, repair_estimate.md and one photo, IMG_0071.jpg. The checklist is complete, and the policy was in force on the 2025-11-18 date of loss. intake.md records that the only damage photo is byte-identical to a photo on a paid Florida claim under a different policy, and adjuster_notes.md asks for an SIU referral before anything else. repair_estimate.md includes an unitemized $403.38 supplies charge that brings the total to exactly the claimed $2,410.00. No account of how the accident happened came through with the retrieved documents, and no photo on file is independent of the prior claim. The claim is routed to specialist review so that a person can examine the duplicate-photo signal and the estimate; what these findings mean for the claim is for the adjuster and specialist to decide.
